description: Create a channel in NextGen Connect that extracts patient data from HL7 messages and writes it to a PostgreSQL database table. The channel should be named 'Patient DB Writer', listen on TCP port 6663 for HL7 messages, and use a Database Writer destination to INSERT patient information (extracted from the PID segment) into a table called 'patient_records'. The table should have columns for patient_id, last_name, first_name, date of birth, and gender. The PostgreSQL database is accessible from inside the NextGen Connect container at jdbc:postgresql://nextgen-postgres:5432/mirthdb (username: postgres, password: postgres). A sample ADT message is at /home/ga/sample_adt_message.hl7. You can use the terminal window to interact with the system. The REST API is at https://localhost:8443/api (credentials: admin/admin). All REST API calls require the header 'X-Requested-With: OpenAPI'. The web dashboard at https://localhost:8443 is monitoring-only. Channel XML must include a <responseTransformer> element in destination connectors.
